story_text:
## Playing Is Easy. Sharing Isn't.
Great moments happen fast. Capturing them shouldn't take a whole desk of gear.
Dock. Capture Card. SSD. PC. Cables.
More devices. More cables. More things to manage — before you even hit record.
No Signal. HDR Lost. Workflow Interrupted.
Your setup shouldn't get between you and the moment.
## Meet Chizha Mount Ling 2 Pro
Mount Ling began with a simple idea: make handheld gaming smarter. With Mount Ling 2 Pro, we took that idea further — from better play to easier creation.
We added capture, streamlined PC-based streaming and recording, expanded support for more handhelds, and brought docking, expandable SSD storage, and real-time system visibility together into one creator-ready workflow.
Built to play. Ready to create.
## Review Updating...
https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/docking-stations-hubs/hands-on-with-the-dockcase-mount-ling-2-pro-handheld-dock-with-a-built-in-capture-card-and-space-for-up-to-4tb-of-nvme-storage
## Simplify Your Content Workflow
What once took a dock, capture card, SSD enclosure, and a mess of cables now comes together in one streamlined setup.
Mount Ling 2 Pro brings 4K60 HDR capture, low-latency gaming, expandable SSD storage, and PC-based streaming and recording into one cleaner workflow — making it easier to go from playing to capturing, streaming, and creating.
Less gear. Less setup. More creating.
## One Dock. Two Simple Ways to Play & Create.
## Vivid Color. Sharper 4K60 Capture
HDR gameplay can lose its punch when converted for an SDR workflow, while lower-resolution capture can soften the details you see on screen.
Mount Ling 2 Pro uses hardware HDR-to-SDR tone mapping to preserve vivid color and highlight detail, while delivering crisp 4K60 capture directly into OBS.
What you see deserves to look just as good when you capture it.
## See Everthing. Stay in Control.
This isn’t just a screen. It’s a real-time window into the critical status behind your gaming and creator workflow.
Mount Ling 2 Pro puts signal health, HDR and capture status, dropped frames, storage, power, temperature, and more right in front of you. Swipe through what matters, catch issues as they happen, and know what needs attention — without guessing what’s happening behind the scenes.
Less checking. Less guessing. More confidence to play and create.
## One Dock. More Ways to Play.
No need to rebuild your setup every time you switch handhelds. Mount Ling 2 Pro works with Nintendo Switch 1&2, Steam Deck, ROG Ally, and more — keeping one streamlined setup ready across your handheld lineup.
Switch devices. Keep your setup.
## See More. Hear More. Feel More.
Whether you're locked into a solo session or sharing the couch with friends, Mount Ling 2 Pro makes every way you play feel more immersive.
4K60 HDR passthrough brings the action to life on the big screen. Optical audio adds richer sound, while adaptive LED lighting extends the atmosphere beyond the display and into the room.
Play solo. Play together. Either way, feel more of the game.
## More Space. More to Play.
Keep more games installed and spend less time deciding what to delete.
Mount Ling 2 Pro features a built-in M.2 SSD slot supporting 2230, 2242, and 2280 drives, with storage expansion up to 4TB. From massive AAA titles to the games you always come back to, there’s more room to keep your favorites ready to play.
With USB 3.2 Gen 2 sequential read and write speeds of up to 1,000MB/s, large files move fast — so more storage doesn’t have to mean a slower experience.
More room. Less deleting. More ready to play.
## Stay Cool. Stay Powered. Keep Playing.
Long sessions demand more than performance — they need heat and power kept under control.
Mount Ling 2 Pro combines an adjustable-speed fan with an optimized thermal design to help manage heat during extended gaming and demanding creator workloads. At the same time, up to 100W PD passthrough keeps your handheld powered through longer sessions.
Less heat to worry about. Less battery anxiety. More time to stay in the game.
## Built to Evolve. Ready for What's Next.
Your handheld keeps evolving. Your dock should too.
Mount Ling 2 Pro supports firmware updates designed to help maintain compatibility as systems and platforms evolve. When an update changes the way your device connects or communicates, the dock can be updated too — helping protect your setup from becoming outdated overnight.
Update. Reconnect. Keep playing and creating.
## Built Around Switch 2. Stable by Design.
Switch 2 changed where the cable connects, so we changed the dock around it.
Mount Ling 2 Pro adds a recessed channel that lets the USB-C cable route cleanly from underneath. Once connected, the handheld naturally settles into the same channel, creating a more secure and stable fit.
What started as a smarter way to route a cable became a better way to support your device — stable enough for tablets and even laptops in our testing.
## Made For Every Creator
From gaming and streaming to recording and content creation, Mount Ling 2 Pro adapts to your workflow. One versatile setup for different creators, different devices, and different ways to create.

Since 2017, Dockcase has been building smarter accessories for the devices people use every day. Across 16 Kickstarter projects, we’ve focused on products including smart USB-C hubs, SSD enclosures, and other thoughtfully engineered electronics designed to make everyday workflows more capable and intuitive.
That experience shaped Mount Ling 2 Pro. From real-time system visibility to high-performance connectivity, storage, capture, cooling, and power, every detail reflects what we’ve learned from years of building for demanding users around the world.
Mount Ling 2 Pro isn’t our first step into smart hardware. It’s the next step in what we’ve been building all along.

faq.q: Does video capture work with Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. When connected to the Nintendo Switch 2, the Mount Ling 2 Pro supports simultaneous 4K60Hz/1080P120Hz screen projection and video capture, and allows you to check the status of the projected and captured video—as well as other connection details—via the touchscreen.

faq.q: Will future Nintendo system updates affect compatibility?
faq.a: Mount Ling 2 Pro features upgradeable firmware. As Nintendo and other platforms evolve, we'll continue providing firmware updates to maintain compatibility whenever possible. While no accessory can guarantee compatibility with every future software change, we're committed to long-term support.

Mount Ling 2 Pro is designed for Nintendo Switch 1/2, Steam Deck LCD/OLED, ROG Ally/Ally X, Legion Go/Go S/Go 2, Windows laptops, and other compatible USB-C devices(like some iPad/iPhone). We'll publish a complete compatibility list before shipping.

Mount Ling 2 Pro supports HDMI screen casting and video capture in formats such as 4K60Hz, 2K144Hz, and 1080P240Hz. It utilizes a dedicated chip to deliver low-latency, high-frame-rate gaming visuals for screen casting, and employs MJPEG for video capture and recording at up to 4K60Hz.

Yes, Mount Ling 2 Pro supports HDR input and HDMI screen casting. During capture, HDR content is automatically tone-mapped to SDR to ensure compatibility with mainstream live streaming platforms and capture software.

Yes. Recording and livestreaming require a PC running capture software such as OBS—just like other professional capture solutions. Mount Ling 2 Pro simplifies the workflow by combining your dock, capture hardware and expandable SSD storage into one intelligent device, reducing cable clutter and setup complexity.

faq.q: Can I livestream directly to Twitch or YouTube?
faq.a: No. Nintendo Switch does not support native livestreaming, and livestreaming still requires a PC with software such as OBS. Mount Ling 2 Pro provides a clean, creator-friendly connection for your streaming setup.

faq.q: How is Mount Ling 2 Pro different from a traditional capture card?
faq.a: Traditional capture cards focus on video capture alone. Mount Ling 2 Pro combines a premium dock, creator-grade capture, expandable SSD storage, and an intelligent touchscreen into a single streamlined creator workflow. It also provides real-time system status that ordinary capture cards simply don't offer.

Mount Ling 2 Pro is engineered for low-latency HDMI passthrough. Unlike traditional capture devices, Mount Ling 2 Pro utilizes dedicated chips for HDMI display and video capture. Its "HDMI-first" technology minimizes gaming latency, ensuring a responsive gameplay experience while you capture your video via your PC.

faq.q: Can I use the built-in SSD as extra game storage for Nintendo Switch?
faq.a: No. Nintendo Switch only supports microSD Express cards for game storage and does not support external USB SSDs for installing games. The SSD inside Mount Ling 2 Pro is designed for storing captured videos and files, and also serves as expandable storage when used with compatible devices such as Steam Deck and Windows handhelds.

faq.q: Does it provide enough power while gaming?
faq.a: Yes. It supports up to 100W USB-C Power Delivery, providing sufficient charging power for demanding handheld gaming devices while connected to your display and creator setup.

faq.q: Can I record gameplay directly to the built-in SSD?
faq.a: In a standard workflow, captured and recorded content is transferred to a separate PC rather than being stored on the Mount Ling 2 Pro's built-in SSD. However, if you are simultaneously gaming and recording on a Windows handheld, you can save the recorded video directly to the device's built-in SSD.

faq.q: Do I need to install any drivers?
faq.a: Mount Ling 2 Pro is designed to work with standard UVC/UAC-compatible capture workflows. Additional software requirements, if any, will be provided before launch.

faq.q: Is the touchscreen required to use the dock?
faq.a: Not at all. The touchscreen provides real-time system information and convenient controls, but the dock functions normally even if you never touch the screen. It simply gives creators much greater visibility and confidence.
